spec = load_spec(root, config.respect_gitignore, config.extra_excludes) prepared = [] skipped: list[str] = []
for path, relative, reason in iter_source_files(root, spec, config.max_file_bytes): if path is None: skipped.append(f"{relative} ({reason})") continue raw_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if config.redact_secrets: raw_text = redact(raw_text) language = language_for(path) prepared.append( prepare_item( relative_path=relative, size_bytes=path.stat().st_size, language=language, raw=raw_text, mode=mode_for(relative, config), pinned=is_focus_pinned(relative, config), ) ) scores = rank_paths( [(item.relative_path, item.raw, item.language) for item in prepared], config.entries, ) for item in prepared: item.rank = scores.get(item.relative_path, 0.0)
fitted = fit_budget(prepared, config.max_tokens) skipped.extend(fitted.omitted)
files = [ FileRecord( relative_path=item.relative_path, size_bytes=item.size_bytes, language=item.language, content=item.content, tokens=item.tokens, applied_mode=item.mode, rank=item.rank, ) for item in fitted.kept ] tree = directory_tree([item.relative_path for item in files]) total_bytes = sum(item.size_bytes for item in files) total_tokens = sum(item.tokens for item in files) markdown = render_markdown( root_name=root.name, files=files, skipped=skipped, tree=tree, total_bytes=total_bytes, total_tokens=total_tokens, ) result = PackResult( root=str(root), files=files, skipped=skipped, tree=tree, markdown=markdown, total_bytes=total_bytes, total_tokens=total_tokens, ) if config.format != "markdown": result.markdown = render_document(result, config.format) return result

import re
REDACTED = "[REDACTED]"
_PATTERNS = ( re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----"), re.compile(r"\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b"), re.compile(r"\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b"), re.compile(r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b"), re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b"), re.compile(r"\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b"), re.compile(r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b"), re.compile( r"(?i)(\b(?:api[_-]?key|secret|token|password|passwd|access[_-]?key|private[_-]?key)\b\s*[=:]\s*)(['\"])[^'\"\n]{8,}\2" ), re.compile(r"(?i)(Authorization:\s*Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,}"), )
